purpose: Use explicit physical-target findings from the actual full-target second inspection, followed by independent metadata/contract review, to avoid a second undocumented reconstruction of those same visual findings.
business_reference_method_unchanged: Independent first AI plus another isolated AI second review, with first answers visible only to the assigned second reviewer; no evaluated prompts, evaluated outputs or source business labels.
physical_blinding_disclosure: Supplemental physical evidence is recorded during second review with first answers visible. It is not a separate blind identity review and cannot be described as one.
input_scope: All 24 assigned cases for bounded_annotator_27 and all 24 for bounded_annotator_28, without favorable business-verdict filtering.
required_visual_findings: A real road target is identifiable in the original image.
The preregistered world scope, both fixed A/B cross-sections and complete width match that physical target.
Whole-boundary support is recorded explicitly true/false/null under the already approved main-road continuous-width rule.
Inspection files and specific physical landmarks/uncertainties are recorded by the actual second observer, never inferred by the root controller.
required_metadata_checks: Exact image, scope, native-window affine and source-georeferencing bindings remain valid under the frozen f132 core.
Physical-ID proposal and asset/site/capture/near-duplicate assignment use the already registered grouping rules; no split or event reassignment to fill counts.
Verify cross-asset nonoverlap conservatively from complete native image envelopes; intersections or ambiguous same-asset relations remain unresolved pending a dedicated identity comparison.
Same proposed asset across captures contributes one primary and separately declared repeats, never multiple primary assets.
Require an independent read-only metadata/contract reviewer to support the populated exact subset and all evidence bindings before any grouping flags are set in a new partial corpus.
not_sufficient: A geometric group alone, alpha availability, matching class, or a root inference is not physical-asset evidence.
Supplemental fields alone do not admit an asset, confirm site independence or prove repeat state.
A valid polygon does not imply a physically supported whole target; null/false physical findings remain unresolved.
This proposal does not resolve missing fixed task polygons for indeterminate images or preregister wrong-target tasks.
